candidate_name: Montenegro LNG terminal & gas-fired power plant (JERA feasibility-study MoU)
sponsor_or_proposer: JERA Co., Inc. (with Government of Montenegro / Ministry of Energy and Mining)
current_state: Government-level MoU signed 11 Sep 2025 at Gastech 2025 (Milan) by Energy & Mining Minister Admir Sahmanovic and JERA chief global strategist Steve Winn, to conduct a feasibility study on an LNG terminal + associated gas-fired power plant. Feasibility study explicitly analyzes MULTIPLE potential locations -- no single site (e.g. Port of Bar) confirmed. Distinct from the existing GEM 'Bar LNG Terminal' record (LNG Alliance Pte Ltd + EPCG), which was excluded from the Spatial Plan through 2040.
missing_threshold_elements: No confirmed location/site (multi-site study still open); no defined capacity; no FID/financing; pre-feasibility stage only. Does not yet meet the discovery add-bar (sponsor + approx location + concrete step).
watch_for: Completion of the JERA feasibility study; selection of a specific site (whether Port of Bar -- which would update the existing record -- or a new location, which would be a new terminal); a stated capacity; any project implementation agreement / FID. Also watch whether JERA effectively supersedes the LNG Alliance/EPCG Bar proposal.
